statements.t: During the second quarter, the Company concentrated personnel and capital on two initiatives intended to strengthen the commercial foundation of its travel advisor and media businesses:
The Company also expects these initiatives to create opportunities across creator commerce, sponsorship, event revenue and travel bookings.
NextTrip expects operating activity to strengthen and ramp during the second half of fiscal 2027 as the Company transitions from platform integration and product enhancement toward commercialization.

During the balance of fiscal 2027, management expects the most relevant indicators of operating progress to include NextTrip Pro advisor onboarding and booking activity; JOURNY TV audience, advertising-impression and monetization metrics; broader deployment and engagement of JOURNYGO; cruise and group-travel bookings; and initial contributions from YADA Commerce and NextTrip LIVE initiatives.

Complete financial results for the quarter and six months ended August 31, 2026, including operating expenses, net loss, loss per share, cash and liquidity information, will be included in the Company’s Quarterly Report on Form 10-Q to be filed with the U.S.
